# Mantis Design System

> The Mantis token layer (one dark, cinematic theme: the reference's source tokens plus semantic roles) and the core component set. Install this first; it is the one-install entry point for the design system. Version 0.1.0.

Install any item with the shadcn CLI: `npx shadcn@latest add https://mantis-gold.vercel.app/r/base.json` for the base theme first, then components and blocks the same way. With the `@mantis` registry in your components.json, `npx shadcn@latest add @mantis/<name>` works too.

## Theming

- **One theme: `dark`.** It ships at `html:root` and applies everywhere. There is no other mode: never add a theme toggle, alternate-mode styles or `data-theme` islands.
- **Accent** — one: it lives under `color.accent` as ordinary values, not a runtime-switchable variant.
- **Overriding a variable in your app** — write `html:root { --primary: … }`, **not** `:root { … }`. The theme ships at `html:root` (specificity 0,1,1), so a bare `:root` override (0,1,0) silently loses no matter where it appears in the cascade.
- **Radius, type, spacing and shadow are exact.** The theme ships its own `@theme inline` block, so `rounded-*`, `text-*`, spacing utilities and `shadow-*` compile to this system's values — once you delete the `--radius-*` and `--font-sans` lines from your own `@theme inline` block (Tailwind resolves duplicate `@theme` keys last-wins, and yours comes after the `@import`).
- **Accessibility** — text ≥ 4.5:1, interactive/non-text ≥ 3:1 (WCAG 2.1 AA). Every token pair the components use is tested.

## Docs

- [Components](https://mantis-gold.vercel.app/llms-components.txt) — every component and block: what it is for, its intent tags, and its usage guide
- [Tokens](https://mantis-gold.vercel.app/llms-tokens.txt) — the semantic color contract, type, radius, shadow and motion, and the source layer
